[RDSC.5a.8.2] One series declaration may emit multiple
distinct backend atoms (e.g., a series with both
`mean, stdev all_time` and `min, max sliding 5_min`
triples emits `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` + `SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque`). These share `(schema_name,
slot_name, identity_slot_name)` but differ in atom, or in
`window_ns` where the declaration observes the slot at more
than one window; the runtime treats them as parallel backends,
each keyed by the full tuple of [RDSC.5a.8.1].
